One Pan Garlic Parmesan Chicken Bake🔥410 cals 37g protein 11g fat 40g carbs Cookbook in bio 🔗 Ingredients: this makes 6 meals 1.5 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-sized pieces 1 ½ cups jasmine rice, uncooked 3 cups chicken broth, warmed 1 medium yellow onion, diced 1 red bell pepper, diced 1 ½ cups cherry tomatoes, halved 2 cups baby spinach, roughly chopped 4 cloves garlic, minced 50g freshly grated Parmesan cheese 2 tsp Italian seasoning 1 ½ tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder ¾ tsp smoked paprika ¾ tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper ¼ tsp red pepper flakes (optional) ¼ cup fresh parsley, finely chopped Directions 1. Preheat oven to 400°F 2. Add chicken thigh, 1 ½ cups uncooked rice, diced onion, red bell pepper, cherry tomatoes, spinach, and minced garlic directly to the baking dish. 3. Season with 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 ½ tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, ¾ tsp smoked paprika, ¾ tsp salt, ½ tsp black pepper, and red pepper flakes if using. 4. Pour in 3 cups chicken broth and stir everything together until evenly combined and the rice is submerged. 5. Cover the baking dish tightly with foil and bake at 400°F for 45 minutes. 6. Remove the foil and add fresh parm and go back in the oven uncovered for another 15 mins at 400° 7. Finish with the remaining fresh parsley  Serve hot and enjoy! Ingredients: * Cajun sausage * Medium shrimp, peeled and deveined, tails removed * Salt * Black pepper * Onion powder * Garlic powder * Cayenne pepper * Paprika * Red pepper flakes * Parmesan cheese * Heavy cream * Butter * Rigatoni or pasta of choice * Fresh parsley * Sliced baguette Instructions: * Season shrimp and sliced Cajun sausage with salt, pepper, onion powder, garlic powder, cayenne, paprika, and red pepper flakes. * Melt butter in a large pan and cook sausage until browned. Add shrimp and cook until pink and opaque. Remove both and set aside. * Boil pasta in salted water until al dente. Meanwhile, toast baguette slices in butter until golden and crispy. * In the same pan used for the shrimp and sausage, melt additional butter and pour in heavy cream. Stir over medium-low heat to create a smooth sauce. * Gradually add grated Parmesan cheese, stirring until melted and thickened. Add additional seasonings to taste. * Add cooked pasta and toss until evenly coated in the creamy Cajun sauce. Add a splash of pasta water if needed. * Return the cooked shrimp and sausage to the sauce, reserving a few pieces for plating. Mix well. * Plate the pasta and top with reserved shrimp and sausage. Finish with freshly chopped parsley for color. * Serve with toasted buttered baguette slices on the side for dipping into the sauce!  #food #pasta #easyrecipe #cooking #dinnerideas

Creamy Cajun Chicken & Rice✨🌶️🍗 #dinnerideas #easyrecipes #quickdinner #weeknightmeals #onepanmeal  Recipe: * 6–8 boneless, skinless chicken thighs * Avocado oil * Cajun seasoning * Paprika * Onion powder * 1 packet sazon * Garlic powder * Salt, to taste * Black pepper, to taste * 1 tbsp butter * 1 diced onion * 4 cloves garlic, minced * 1 red bell pepper, diced * 1 orange bell pepper, diced * Cooked white rice * Fresh parsley, for topping Creamy Cajun Garlic Sauce * 2 tbsp butter * 2–3 cloves garlic, minced * Paprika, to taste * Cajun seasoning, to taste *Italian seasoning  * 1 cup heavy cream Instructions 1. Season the chicken:     Add the chicken thighs to a large bowl. Drizzle with avocado oil and season with Cajun seasoning, paprika, sazon, onion powder, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper. Mix well until the chicken is evenly coated. 2. Cook the chicken:     Heat a large pan over medium-high heat and add a little avocado oil or butter. Sear the chicken thighs on both sides until golden brown and cooked through, reaching an internal temperature of 165°F. Remove the chicken from the pan and set aside. 3. Cook the vegetables:     In the same pan, add 1 tablespoon of butter. Add the diced onion and minced garlic and sauté until fragrant. Add the diced red and orange bell peppers and cook for a few minutes until softened. Season with a little more Cajun seasoning. 4. Add the rice:     Once the vegetables are softened and slightly browned, add your cooked white rice to the pan. Mix everything together well so the rice is coated with all those Cajun flavors. 5. Add the chicken:     Place the cooked chicken thighs on top of the rice and vegetables. 6. Make the creamy Cajun sauce:     In a small saucepan, melt 2 tablespoons of butter over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and sauté for about 30 seconds, until fragrant. Add paprika and Cajun seasoning, italian seasoning and stir to combine. Pour in 1 cup of heavy cream and bring it to a gentle simmer. Continue stirring until the sauce begins to thicken. 7. Bring it all together:     Pour the creamy Cajun garlic sauce over the chicken and rice. Garnish with fresh parsley. 🌿

Recipe Name Cheesy Crunchy Beef Tacos Ingredients 1. 1 lb (450 g) ground beef 2. 8 hard taco shells 3. 1 tbsp olive oil 4. 1 small onion, diced 5. 2 garlic cloves, minced 6. 1 packet (1 oz) taco seasoning 7. 1/2 cup water 8. 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese 9. 1/2 cup Monterey Jack cheese, shredded 10. 1/2 cup heavy cream 11. 2 oz cream cheese, softened 12. 1/2 tsp paprika 13. 1/2 tsp chili powder 14. 1/4 tsp black pepper 15. 1 diced tomato 16. 2 tbsp chopped fresh cilantro Recipe 1. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. 2. Add the onion and cook until softened, then stir in the garlic. 3. Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it into crumbles. 4. Drain excess grease and mix in the taco seasoning and water. 5. Simmer for 5 minutes until the mixture thickens. 6. In a small saucepan, melt the cream cheese with the heavy cream. 7. Stir in the cheddar, Monterey Jack, paprika, chili powder, and black pepper until smooth. 8. Fill each taco shell with the seasoned beef. 9. Spoon the warm cheese sauce over the beef. 10. Top with diced tomatoes and fresh cilantro. 11. Serve immediately while the shells stay crispy. Follow for more delicious recipes!

🍫 Knock Me Naked Cake A rich, chocolatey Butterfinger poke cake loaded with sweetened condensed milk, Cool Whip, and caramel! Ingredients 1 box Duncan Hines Devil’s Food Cake Mix 4 eggs 1 cup milk 1 stick butter, melted 1 can sweetened condensed milk 1 bag fun-size Butterfinger candy bars, crushed 2 containers Cool Whip Caramel sauce, for drizzling Instructions 1. Prepare the cake: Preheat your oven to 350°F. Mix together the cake mix, eggs, milk, and melted butter until well combined. Pour into a greased 9×13-inch baking dish. 2. Bake: Bake for 29–30 minutes, depending on your oven, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. 3. Poke & pour: While the cake is still warm, poke holes all over the top. Pour the entire can of sweetened condensed milk evenly over the cake, allowing it to soak into the holes. 4. Add the Butterfingers: Crush the entire bag of fun-size Butterfinger candy bars. Sprinkle half of the crushed candy over the cake and save the remaining half for topping. 5. Cool completely: Allow the cake to cool completely before adding the topping. 6. Finish it off: Spread both containers of Cool Whip evenly over the cake. Sprinkle the remaining crushed Butterfingers on top and finish with a generous drizzle of caramel sauce. 7. Refrigerate & serve: Cover and store the cake in the refrigerator until ready to serve. Keep any leftovers refrigerated. 🤎 Kalyn’s Tip: This cake is delicious served cold! Give it time to chill so all that sweetened condensed milk can soak into the chocolate cake. #KnockMeNakedCake #ButterfingerCake #PokeCake #SouthernDesserts #EasyDessert

YALL COME EAT it’s my viral sausage tortellini. 🤤  This recipe has nearly 5 million views on TikTok, so I thought it was time for an official step-by-step.  1. Cook 1 bag of tortellini according to the package directions. Drain and set aside. 2. Add 2 packs of sliced andouille sausage and cook until browned and heated through. Remove the sausage and set aside. 3. In the same skillet, add 1 small finely chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3–4 minutes. Add 2 cloves minced garlic and cook for another 30 seconds. 4. Add 8–10 halved cherry tomatoes, 2 tablespoons chopped sun-dried tomatoes and 1 tablespoon tomato paste. Stir everything together and cook for 2–3 minutes. 5. Season with 1 teaspoon oregano, 1 teaspoon basil, 1 teaspoon parsley, 1 teaspoon smoked paprika, 1 teaspoon garlic powder and 1 teaspoon onion powder. Add salt and pepper to taste. 6. Pour in 1 cup heavy cream and stir to combine. Bring the sauce to a gentle simmer, then add ½ cup shredded Parmesan cheese. Stir until the Parmesan melts and the sauce becomes creamy. 7. Add 1 cup roughly chopped spinach and stir until wilted. 8. Add the cooked tortellini and browned andouille sausage back into the skillet. Toss everything together until the tortellini and sausage are completely coated in the creamy sauce. Cook for another 1–2 minutes. 9. Garnish with red chili flakes and additional Parmesan cheese, if desired. #viralrecipe #tortellini #easydinnerideas #pastarecipe #familymeal

Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken & Rice This Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken & Rice is a cozy, comforting dinner featuring juicy golden chicken served over fluffy rice with a rich, buttery Parmesan garlic sauce. It's simple enough for busy weeknights but delicious enough to feel like a special homemade meal. Ingredients • 1 1/2 pounds chicken tenderloins • 3 cups cooked white rice • 2 tablespoons olive oil • 3 tablespoons butter • 4 cloves garlic, minced • 1 cup chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream • 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese • 1 teaspoon Italian seasoning • 1/2 teaspoon paprika • 1/2 teaspoon onion powder • Salt and black pepper, to taste • 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley Instructions Season the chicken with paprika, Italian seasoning, onion powder, salt, and black pepper. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken for 4 to 5 minutes per side until golden brown and fully cooked. Transfer to a plate. Reduce the heat to medium and melt the butter in the same skillet. Add the garlic and sauté for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Pour in the chicken broth and stir, scraping up the browned bits from the bottom of the pan. Add the heavy cream and let the sauce simmer gently for 2 to 3 minutes. Whisk in the Parmesan cheese until the sauce is smooth and creamy. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over the top. Simmer for another 2 minutes. Serve the chicken over warm cooked rice and drizzle generously with the creamy garlic butter sauce. Finish with fresh parsley and extra Parmesan if desired. Prep Time: 10 minutes | Cook Time: 25 minutes | Total Time: 35 minutes Servings: 6 | Calories: About 620 per serving #dinner #easyrecipes #chicken #comfortfood #rice

VIRAL BROTHY BEEF BOWLS 🔥 If you love soup recipes, but want something substantial and super filling, these are one of the best easy weeknight meals. It’s so easy to make, so good, and packed with protei and flavor. These are super filling and come in under 500 calories and 35g protein a bowl. One of my favorite protein hacks is using a really good bone broth.That little Kettle & Fire carton has almost 20g of protein on its own, I used up a cup in the broth, and a cup making the rice instead of water to boost the protein + flavor. Here is how I made it: 1️⃣ Start with 1 lb ground beef in a large pan over medium-high heat. Break it apart as it browns, then add 4 minced garlic cloves, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper, 1/4 tsp red chili flakes, and a generous pinch of salt. Brown it up really well. 2️⃣ For the broth, add 2.5 tbsp red curry paste and 2 minced garlic cloves to a saucepan over medium heat. Stir for 1-2 mins until softened and fragrant. 3️⃣ Pour in 3/4 cup half-and-half (or coconut milk) and 1 cup Kettle & Fire bone broth. Stir everything together until smooth and bring to a gentle simmer. 4️⃣ Season the broth with a generous couple pinches salt, fresh lime juice, and freshly chopped cilantro. Taste and adjust to your liking. You want it creamy, savory, a little spicy, and bright from the lime. 5️⃣ For the quick pickled red onions, super thinly slice 1/2 large red onion and add it to a bowl. Add juice of 1 lemon and sprinkle with sea salt. Mix really well with a fork and let sit 5-10 mins to soften. 6️⃣ Prepare 4 servings rice of choice. I love replacing the water in mine with bone broth for extra flavor + protein. 7️⃣ To assemble, add 3/4 cup cooked rice to a bowl, add 1/4 of the seasoned beef, and ladle 1/4 of the broth over everything. 8️⃣ Top with thinly sliced cucumbers, quick pickled red onions, sesame seeds, Korean chili flakes and plenty of finely chopped fresh cilantro. If you make it, let me know what you think on SHREDHAPPENS! ENJOY! 🙌 #healthyrecipes #healthyfoodshare #goodmoodfood

Marry Me Chicken 🍅✨ A classic dinner idea made a little lighter and packed with protein! This meal is made in one pan and comes together in about 30 minutes. It's the perfect comfort food meal while also helping you hit your protein goals! Makes 4 servings. 4 small chicken breasts (or 2 large cut in half) 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp Italian seasoning ½ tsp paprika ½ tsp garlic powder Salt and black pepper, to taste 3 cloves garlic, minced ¾ cup low-sodium chicken broth ⅓ cup chopped sun-dried tomatoes, drained 1 cup low-fat cottage cheese ½ cup fat-free milk ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese 2 cups fresh spinach Fresh basil, for garnish 1. Blend the cottage cheese and fat-free milk until completely smooth and creamy. 2. Season the chicken with the Italian seasoning, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. 3. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the chicken for 4 minutes per side until golden. Transfer to a plate. 4. Reduce the heat to low-medium and cook the garlic for about 30 seconds until fragrant. 5. Pour in the chicken broth, scraping up any browned bits from the pan. Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes and simmer for 2-3 minutes. 6. Remove the skillet from the heat and let cool for about five minutes. 7. Slowly whisk the cottage cheese mixture into the skillet until smooth. (Make sure tomato mixture is cool enough before adding the cottage cheese to prevent curdling!) 8. Add the spinach and cook until wilted. Add Parmesan and mix until melted. 9. Return the chicken to the skillet and warm over low heat for 3-4 minutes. Garnish with fresh basil and enjoy! Serve over pasta, rice, vegetables or bread. #marrymechicken #easydinnerideas #onepanmeal

VIRAL CARROT WRAPS 🥕 I’ve made a vacation of these with zucchini, pickles, jalapeños, and I had to put a spin on them with carrots. These are probably my second favorite after the zucchini, they come out really good, super pliable/ and they are a touch sweeter which went really well with the toppings I used here. A medium carrot has about 4 net carbs, so this is a great lower carb option if you’re watching carbs. Recipe makes 3-4 wraps Here is how I made it: 1.Preheat oven to 375F.  2.Shred 3 medium carrots into a bowl. Crack in an egg, add 1 cup of shredded pepper jack cheese, toss in 1/2 tbsp smoked paprika, 1/2 tbsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp chipotle pepper (optional), and a small pinch of salt. Mix really well. 3.Grab a cookie sheet, line with parchment paper (important!) and scoop the carrot mixture into circular shapes. You’ll get 3-4 good sized wraps here. 4.Pop it into the oven at 375F for 16-18 minutes. Then remove and let cool for a few minutes while you prep your fillings 5.I spread a base of my homemade guac here. Just mash 2 avocados with the juice of 1 lime, a large handful of freshly chopped cilantro, 1/2 small white onion, a couple pinches of salt, and about a tablespoon of toasted sesame seeds for crunch (optional).  6.I also added some leftover shredded beef (chicken or shrimp work just fine), topped with a tsp of sour cream, some sriracha, and more fresh cilantro. Again, use what you like here! 7.Plate them up and devour. If you make these, be sure to let me know on SHREDHAPPENS - these are a great lowcarb wrap or lower crab bread option, and a great way to sneak in some extra veggies. ENJOY! . . . . #lowcarb #lowcarbrecipes #healthyrecipe #goodmoodfood #healthyfoodshare #whatsonmyplate

How to build an AI employee that works while you sleep. An AI agent is just a loop (goal → step → check → repeat) that can reach for tools. On its own it hits a wall: it forgets everything, waits for you, owns nothing. The ladder that turns it into staff: • ① context — files YOU write; it reads them every run so nothing's generic, and they grow (you're raising it) • ② memory — facts + your rules + how-to's; a skill is a memory • ③ a lane, not a task • ④ tools — MCP, ~1 min to connect • ⑤ a schedule — wakes on its own, pings you only for decisions • ⑥ guardrails — low-stakes it does; high-stakes it drafts and waits for your yes I run mine from a Google Sheet — it drafts every reply in my voice, I approve in 10 minutes, every 30 minutes it sends the approved ones and learns from my revisions. The moat: anyone can buy the same AI. Nobody has your context. Come build it with me. #aiemployee #aiagent #aiautomation #professorglitch

THE ONE YOU’VE ALL BEEN WAITING FOR: COLLAGEN CHAT (Girl Science Edition) 🩷 First up, collagen is important. It’s what keeps your skin bouncy, joints cushioned, and tissues strong. Your body makes collagen, but rom your mid-20s, that production starts to dip – and drops faster post-menopause thanks to hormonal changes. DO YOU NEED TO TAKE A COLLAGEN SUPPLEMENT? Collagen supplements don’t “top up” your collagen directly. They’re broken down into small peptides that signal your body to make more, but only if your body’s in the right state to respond. That generally comes from you sleeping well, eating a balanced diet with enough protein and managing your stress, Without those foundations, the signal’s weak – and your collagen powder probably won’t do much. Where collagen actually delivers: 💞Joints: Hydrolysed or type II collagen can help reduce joint pain and slow cartilage breakdown (especially if osteoarthritis runs in your family). 🌟Skin: Evidence is mixed. High-quality, independent studies show minimal benefit for elasticity or hydration. 💅Hair & nails: Not much science here yet. Takehome message: collagen can support you, but it’s not a miracle. Focus on your foundations first – balanced nutrition, sleep, and stress management – and collagen becomes the cherry on top, not the whole sundae 🍒 #collagen #collagenforwomen #girlscience #womenshealth #hormonehealth

High Protein Creamy Cajun Chicken & Rice🍗🍘 57g Protein Meal Prep💪🏼 (Macros: Per Serving - 6 Total) 562 Calories 56gC | 11gF | 57gP Ingredients: 1.2KG Thinly Sliced Boneless & Skinless Chicken Breast (raw weight) 2 Tsp Cajun Seasoning 2 Tsp Olive Oil 1/2 Diced Brown Onion 500g Diced Capsicum/Bell Peppers 4 Diced Garlic Cloves 30g Light Butter (Nuttelex Light) 1/2 Tsp Cajun Seasoning 960g Cooked White Rice Creamy Cajun Sauce: 30g Light Butter (Nuttelex Light) 1/2 Tsp Cajun Seasoning 400ml Fat Free Evaporated Milk (Carnation Light & Creamy) 150g Light Cream Cheese 1/2 Tsp Chilli Powder 1 Tsp Smoked Paprika 30g Grated Parmesan Cheese Steps:  1. Start by seasoning your thinly cut/butterflied chicken breast generously on each side with cajun seasoning, olive oil & mix well until each piece is fully coated. 2. Cook the chicken on medium - high heat for approximately 4 minutes on each side, once cooked set it aside. 3. Leave the chicken juice in the pan & cook diced brown onion, diced capsicum/bell peppers & diced garlic cloves until softened. 4. Add light butter to the middle of the pan with a bit of cajun seasoning & let the seasoning toast for approximately 1 minute, then add cooked white rice & mix well until fully incorporated. 5. To a seperate pan on medium heat add light butter with a bit more cajun seasoning, after about 1 minute add light evaporated milk with a bit more cajun seasoning, smoked paprika, grated parmesan cheese & mix until smooth & creamy. 6. Street Corn Chicken Bowls: Gut Healthy Edition 🌽 @Nature Made  Juicy spiced chicken, the most addictive green sauce you've ever made, and a zesty street corn salad. High protein, gut-healthy and paired with my daily Nature Made Probiotic + Prebiotic Fiber Gummies… weeknight approved 🫡 #partner For the Chicken: -1.5 lbs (680g) boneless, skinless chicken thighs -Seasoning: 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tbsp chili powder, 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp oregano, 2 tsp salt, 1 tsp pepper -3 tbsp olive oil -6 garlic cloves, minced -1 lime, juiced For the Street Corn: -30 oz (850 g) corn kernels (or 4 cobs) -⅓ cup red onion, finely diced -1 fresh jalapeno, diced (deseeded) -½ avocado, cubed -¼ cup fresh cilantro, chopped -⅓ cup cotija cheese (or feta), crumbled -Seasonings: 2 tsp chile lime, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp pepper -¼ cup greek yogurt -¼ cup mayonnaise -½ lime, juiced For the Aji Verde: -½ cup greek yogurt -½ cup mayonnaise  -1 small jalapeño, deseeded -1 1/2 cups cilantro, leaves and stems -4 to 5 garlic cloves -2 tsp black pepper -1 tsp salt -Juice of 1 lime Instructions: 1. In a bowl, combine the chicken with the spices, olive oil, garlic and lime juice. Mix well & marinate for as long as your patience can handle. 2. For even more flavor, char the corn in a hot skillet for 5–7 with a splash of neutral oil before mixing with the remaining street corn ingredients. Refrigerate. 3. To a food processor or blender, add all of the Aji Verde ingredients and blend until smooth & vibrant green. 4. I recommend making rice for the bowls! 2 cups of long grain white rice should do the trick. Once done, fluff with 2 tbsp olive oil, ¼ cup fresh cilantro and a splash of lime juice. 5. Heat a large pan over medium-high heat & add a drizzle of olive oil. Once hot, add the chicken in batches. Cook for 6 to 8 mins per side until golden & cooked through. Set aside. 6. Assemble your bowls with the rice, chicken, street corn salad, a generous drizzle of aji verde, extra cotija, and fresh cilantro. Enjoy :)

💥bang bang chicken 🍗 Ingredients  1.5 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs season to your hearts desire  salt and pepper onion powder  garlic powder  smoked paprika  Sauce 1/2 cup Kewpie mayo @Kewpieusa  3 tbsp sweet chili sauce  Sriracha to taste  1/2 tbsp lime juice  Instructions  1. Pre heat air fryer to 380°F. Clean and trim off excess fat from chicken thighs and pat dry. Place chicken on a baking sheet or mixing bowl, add seasonings to taste. Drizzle with oil and mix to thoroughly combine ensuring all sides are evenly coated. 2. Air fry chicken thighs at 380°F for 12 to 18 minutes, flipping halfway through. Cook until the thickest part of the chicken reaches internal temp of 165°F. 3. While chicken is cooking make the bang bang sauce. Reserve some sauce for topping. Brush remaining sauce to coat top of each chicken thigh. Crank heat up to 400°F or if you have the @From Our Place air fryer like me, switch it to low broil. Cook for an additional 5 minutes until sauce thickens.  4. Serve with rice, garnish with reserved sauce, parsley or chopped green onions and sesame seeds. Enjoy!

Apple Cider Donut Muffins 🍎🍂 (recipe makes 12 muffins) Apple Cider Reduction: 1½ cups apple cider, reduced to ½ cup, then cooled Batter: ½ cup (113g) unsalted butter, melted & slightly cooled ¾ cup (150g) brown sugar, packed ¼ cup (50g) granulated sugar 2 eggs, room temp 2 tsp vanilla extract  ½ cup (120g) sour cream, room temp ½ cup reduced apple cider, cooled 2 cups (240g) all-purpose flour, spooned & leveled or weighed (don’t pack it in)  1¼ tsp baking powder ½ tsp baking soda ½ tsp salt 1½ tsp cinnamon ¼ tsp nutmeg ⅛ tsp allspice  Pinch of cloves Cinnamon Sugar: ⅓ cup sugar 1-1½ tsp cinnamon 3 tbsp melted unsalted butter (for brushing) Instructions: Pour the 1½ cups of apple cider into a saucepan and simmer over medium heat until reduced to ½ cup (~20-30 minutes). Pour into a shallow dish to cool to room temperature. Preheat oven to 400°F. Line a standard 12-cup muffin pan with liners. Whisk together the melted butter and both sugars until smooth.  Mix in the eggs and vanilla, followed by the sour cream, and reduced cider. In a separate bowl, combine flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt, and spices.  Fold the dry ingredients into the wet ingredients until just combined, some small lumps are ok. Don’t over mix. Spoon the batter into the liners.  Bake at 400°F for 5 minutes. Without opening the door, reduce the oven to 350°F and continue baking for 15-20 minutes. A toothpick inserted in the center should come out clean/mostly clean. Let them cool for ~10 minutes or until warm but not hot. Brush melted butter over the warm muffins and roll in cinnamon sugar.  Enjoy! #bakingrecipe #appleciderdonuts #applecider #muffins #fallrecipes

Honey Crispy Chicken Ingredients 	•	2 lbs chicken breasts, cubed 	•	2 eggs, beaten 	•	1 ½ cups cornstarch 	•	2 Tbsp soy sauce 	•	½ tsp black pepper 	•	¼ cup brown sugar 	•	¾ cup butter 	•	3–4 cloves garlic, minced 	•	¼ tsp red pepper flakes 	•	¼ cup soy sauce 	•	½ cup honey 	•	1 Tbsp water 	•	1 Tbsp cornstarch (for slurry) 	•	Vegetable oil, for frying 	•	Steamed white rice, for serving ⸻ Instructions 	1.	Prepare the Chicken: 	•	In a bowl, mix chicken cubes with eggs, 2 Tbsp soy sauce, and black pepper. 	•	Add cornstarch and toss until chicken is well coated. 	2.	Fry the Chicken: 	•	Heat vegetable oil in a deep skillet or wok over medium-high heat. 	•	Fry chicken in batches for 5–7 minutes, until golden brown and cooked through. 	•	Remove and drain on paper towels. 	3.	Make the Honey Sauce: 	•	In a saucepan over medium heat, melt the butter. 	•	Add garlic and red pepper flakes, sauté until fragrant. 	•	Stir in brown sugar, ¼ cup soy sauce, and honey. Bring to a gentle boil. 	•	Mix 1 Tbsp water with 1 Tbsp cornstarch in a small bowl to make a slurry. Whisk into the sauce and cook for 2–3 minutes until thickened. 	4.	Combine & Serve: 	•	Add fried chicken to the sauce and toss until coated evenly. 	•	Serve hot over a bed of steamed white rice. #chicken #fyp #fypシ #viral #recipe

✨ Cheesy Meat-Stuffed Breakfast Biscuits ✨ A delicious, flaky, and cheese-packed comfort food recipe featuring golden-brown biscuits stuffed with savory ground meat and melted cheese. 🍴 Ingredients: - 1 package refrigerated biscuit dough or homemade biscuit dough - 1 lb ground beef or sausage, cooked and seasoned - 1.5 cups shredded cheddar cheese - 2 tbsp melted butter - 1 tsp garlic powder - Fresh parsley, finely chopped for garnish - Salt and freshly cracked black pepper to taste 👩🏽‍🍳 Instructions: 1. Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. 2. Cook the ground meat in a skillet with salt, pepper, and garlic powder until fully browned, then drain excess fat. 3. Separate the biscuit dough, flatten each piece slightly, and place a spoonful of cooked meat and a generous amount of shredded cheese in the center. 4. Fold the dough securely around the filling to form stuffed biscuit balls or rounds, pinching the edges to seal. 5. Arrange the stuffed biscuits on the prepared baking sheet. 6. Brush the tops with melted butter and sprinkle a little extra cheese or parsley on top. 7. Bake in the preheated oven for 15 to 18 minutes until the biscuits are golden brown and cooked through. 8. Remove from the oven, let cool slightly, and serve warm. 📝 Notes: These flaky, cheese-stuffed biscuits make the ultimate grab-and-go breakfast, packed with rich flavor in every single bite. #BreakfastBiscuits #StuffedBiscuits #CheeseLovers #ComfortFood #SavoryBaking

Grilled Teriyaki Chicken 🔥🍗 Cook Like an Asian Ep 1: Grilled Teriyaki Chicken. Welcome to my series, where I teach you easy Asian recipes so good, your friends will think you’re Asian. 🤙🏽 Sweet, savory, garlicky chicken thighs grilled over charcoal for smoky flavor and a beautiful char. This is the series where I bring the recipes, and you take the credit. 🙌🏽 Ingredients: 2 lb boneless chicken thighs ½ cup shoyu (soy sauce) ½ cup brown sugar 5 garlic cloves, crushed 1 tbsp crushed ginger 1 tbsp sesame oil 1 tbsp rice vinegar 1 tsp mirin Instructions: 1. Mix the shoyu, brown sugar, garlic, ginger, sesame oil, rice vinegar, and mirin until combined. 2. Reserve ¼ cup of marinade BEFORE adding the raw chicken. Refrigerate separately for brushing during the cook. 3. Place chicken in a zip-top bag and pour in the remaining marinade. Seal, massage to coat, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or overnight. 4. Fire up your charcoal grill. Once the coals are hot, keep one side cooler so you can move the chicken if it browns too quickly.  5. Remove chicken from the bag and discard the used marinade. Grill over the hot coals, flipping and brushing both sides with the reserved marinade to build that beautiful char. 6. Move to the cooler side as needed to prevent burning, and cook until the thickest part reaches 165°F. 7. Rest for 5 minutes, then slice and serve with hot rice! 🍚 Don’t let these ingredients intimidate you because I got all of them from my local Walmart! #teriyakichicken #asianfood #easyrecipe

Sweet, savory, and packed with bold garlic flavor 🧄🍗 — this Garlic Brown Sugar Chicken is sticky, caramelized perfection and comes together fast! ⸻ 🍗 Garlic Brown Sugar Chicken ⭐ Ingredients 	•	4 boneless, skinless chicken breasts (or thighs) 	•	Salt & black pepper 	•	1 tsp paprika 	•	2 tbsp olive oil Garlic Brown Sugar Sauce: 	•	½ cup packed brown sugar 	•	4 cloves garlic, minced 	•	2 tbsp soy sauce 	•	1 tbsp Dijon mustard (optional, for depth) 	•	1 tbsp apple cider vinegar or lemon juice 	•	½ tsp crushed red pepper (optional) ⸻ 👩‍🍳 Directions 	1.	Season chicken: Pat chicken dry and season both sides with salt, pepper, and paprika. 	2.	Sear: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Simmer: Reduce heat to medium-low. Pour sauce into skillet. Spoon sauce over chicken and simmer 5–7 minutes until sauce thickens and chicken is cooked through. 	5.	Serve: Spoon extra caramelized garlic sauce over top before serving. ⸻ 🍽️ Serve With 	•	White or jasmine rice 	•	Roasted broccoli 	•	Mashed potatoes ⸻ ✨ Tips 	•	Chicken thighs stay extra juicy 	•	For thicker sauce, simmer a few extra minutes 	•	Add a splash of pineapple juice for a sweet tropical twist Sticky, garlicky, and perfectly sweet — a guaranteed weeknight favorite 💛 #foodie #foodtok #recipe #dinner #chicken

You already know this Cowboy Mashed Potato Casserole is gonna be GOOD! 🤠 To get the recipe, click the link in @allrecipes bio or continue reading! ⬇️ Ingredients: cooking spray 6 strips bacon 2 pounds baking potatoes, peeled and chopped 1 (5 ounce) can evaporated milk or whole milk 2 tablespoons butter 1 1/2 teaspoons salt, divided 1/2 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper, divided 1 pound ground beef 1 cup chopped onion 1 green bell pepper, chopped 1 cup frozen whole kernel corn 2 cloves garlic, minced 1 1/2 teaspoons smoked paprika 1/4 cup barbecue sauce 1 tablespoon Worcestershire sauce 1 teaspoon Dijon mustard 1/2 cup shredded Cheddar or pepper Jack cheese 1/4 cup canned French fried onions 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh parsley Directions: Gather all ingredients. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F. Grease a 2-quart baking dish with cooking spray. Place dish on a baking sheet. Cook bacon in a large skillet over medium, turning occasionally, until crisp, about 10 minutes. Place bacon on a paper towel to drain. Drain all but 1 Tbsp of bacon fat in the skillet. Chop bacon when cool enough to handle. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add potatoes and return to a boil. Cook, covered, until potatoes are fork tender, 15-20 minutes. Drain potatoes. Return potatoes back to the pot along with evaporated milk, butter, 1/2 tsp salt, and 1/2 tsp pepper. Mash potatoes with a potato masher until smooth. Stir 1/4 c chopped bacon into mashed potatoes. Add ground beef, onion, and bell pepper to the skillet with reserved bacon fat. Cook over medium until meat is browned and cooked through, stirring occasionally, 8-10 minutes. Add corn kernels, garlic, and paprika to the skillet. Cook and stir for 1 minute. Stir in barbecue sauce, Worcestershire sauce, mustard, remaining 1 tsp salt, and 1/2 tsp pepper. Spread ground beef mixture in prepared baking dish. Spread potatoes evenly over beef. Sprinkle with cheese, remaining bacon, and French fried onions. Bake until bubbly and cheese is melted, 20-25 minutes. Garnish with parsley. 👨‍🍳: Nicole McLaughlin #cowboycasserole #mashedpotatoes #easydinners #dinnerideas

🧀 Crispy Parmesan Chicken with Garlic Potatoes & Green Beans 🍗🥔 This Crispy Parmesan Chicken with Garlic Potatoes & Green Beans is an easy sheet-pan dinner packed with bold flavor. Juicy oven-roasted chicken is coated in a crispy Parmesan crust, while buttery garlic potatoes and tender green beans roast alongside for a complete, satisfying family meal with minimal cleanup. Ingredients For the Chicken • 4 boneless, skinless chicken breasts • 2 tbsp olive oil • ¾ cup grated Parmesan cheese • ½ cup panko breadcrumbs • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp Italian seasoning • ½ tsp smoked paprika • ¾ tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper For the Potatoes • 1½ lbs baby Yukon Gold potatoes, halved • 1 tbsp olive oil • 2 tbsp melted butter • 1 tsp garlic powder • ½ tsp paprika • Salt and black pepper, to taste For the Green Beans • 12 oz fresh green beans, trimmed • 1 tbsp olive oil • 2 garlic cloves, minced • 1 tbsp melted butter • Salt and black pepper, to taste For Garnish • 2 tbsp chopped fresh parsley • Lemon wedges Instructions 1. Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Lightly grease a large sheet pan or line it with parchment paper. 2. Toss the potatoes with olive oil, melted butter, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper. Spread them evenly on one side of the pan and roast for 15 minutes. 3. In a shallow bowl, combine the Parmesan cheese, panko breadcrumbs, garlic powder, Italian seasoning, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper. 4. Brush both sides of the chicken breasts with olive oil, then press them firmly into the Parmesan mixture until well coated. 5. Remove the sheet pan from the oven and move the potatoes to one side. Arrange the coated chicken in the center. 6. Toss the green beans with olive oil, melted butter, minced garlic, salt, and pepper, then place them beside the chicken. 7. Bake for 20–25 minutes, or until the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C) and the potatoes are fork-tender. 8. Switch the oven to broil and cook for 2–3 minutes until the Parmesan crust is extra crispy and golden. 9. Sprinkle with fresh parsley and serve with lemon wedges. Serving Suggestions Serve with Caesar salad, garlic bread, roasted carrots, steamed broccoli, or creamy ranch dipping sauce for a complete restaurant-style dinner. Storage Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 4 days. Reheat in the oven or air fryer to keep the chicken crispy. Prep Time: 15 minutes Cook Time: 40 minutes Total Time: 55 minutes Servings: 4 Calories: Approximately 610 per serving #ParmesanChicken #SheetPanDinner #EasyDinner #ComfortFood #FamilyMeals
